companyLookup.title: Is your company affected by NIS2?
companyLookup.subtitle: The binding determination is made by your national supervisory authority. Below are the official contact points per country, plus a free self-check for orientation. Not sure? See <link>real-world edge cases</link> for examples.

authorityCallout.heading: Binding determination: your national supervisory authority
authorityCallout.body: The final NIS2 classification is made by the competent authority in your country. We link the official sources — the self-check below is only a quick orientation tool.

companyLookup.selfCheckSubtitle: Orientation by sector, size, and special cases — does not replace the official determination by your authority.
companyLookup.noResults: No companies found. Check the spelling or try the full legal name.
companyLookup.error: Company lookup is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
companyLookup.missingData: Some data could not be retrieved automatically. The classification is based on available information and may change when all data is available.
companyLookup.disclaimer: Company data is sourced from public registers and stored to improve our service.
companyLookup.holdingWarning: This company appears to be a holding or group parent. NIS2 applicability is assessed per entity — subsidiaries with their own operations, employees, and IT systems may be independently in scope, even if the holding itself is not. Check each subsidiary separately.
companyLookup.resultDisclaimer: This is an indicative assessment based on publicly available register data, not a legal determination. Actual NIS2 applicability depends on factors not fully captured here. Consult a qualified advisor to confirm.

reason.excluded: Your organization appears to be exempt from NIS2 scope.
reason.no_sector: None of the registered industry codes appear to fall under a NIS2 sector.
reason.below_threshold: Your company appears to operate in a NIS2 sector but may be below the size threshold based on available data.
reason.special_case: Based on its classification, your organization likely falls in scope regardless of size.
reason.size_and_sector: Based on available data, both sector and size criteria for NIS2 appear to be met.
